fold_rationale.category_holdouts: Five outer folds: all6objects in one geometry category test;12A objects from other categories train and12distinctB objects validation. The held category appears in neither train nor validation.
fold_rationale.grouping: All views/seeds/scenarios/repeats/trajectory windows of a physical object remain in its partition.
limitations: These small folds are for pipeline coverage and tentative estimates, not evidence that a predictor is adequately trained.
Category folds share scene/background identities across different objects in remaining and held categories; they support a geometry holdout claim, not an unseen-camera/scene claim.
Whole-scene purging would empty training for this matrix because the held category spans every scene.
State-prefix inputs exclude image/background/asset/category identity and future labels; nevertheless scene correlation must be disclosed.
A new prospective split does not overwrite earlier historical whole-category-validation protocols.
fold_rationale.object_holdouts: Two reciprocal outer folds:15test objects, one per cell; among15remaining,5distinct validation objects, one per category at predeclared size, and10train. All categories appear in train, but one size/cell per category is reserved for validation.

future_collection_contract: Freeze controller/profile/scorer/feature cutoff and budgets after gravity/approach/multifinger qualification and before task outcomes.
Compare pre-lift state/command prefixes only. Future lift/drop/hold events provide labels, never input features.
Approach failures preceding cutoff belong to an already-failed risk set, not prospective warning successes. Mapping/setup/numerical/runtime refusals retain null physical labels.
Use measured success/failure definitions and retain failed proposals. Do not use analytic quality or generator score as task ground truth.
Declare physical-randomization blocks separately from observation noise, and audit actual effective contact parameters.

MuJoCo higher-priority geom controls contact friction; equal priority uses elementwise maximum. Object friction alone may have no effect if hand friction dominates. Verify actual contact friction/priority or qualify a separately declared pair/both-geom intervention.
Training-only normalization, validation-only tuning, fixed0.5threshold, unchanged cutoff and same held rows for model comparisons; class-degenerate folds explicitly undefined.

pilot.repeat_budget: Separately declared by frozen inference protocol; repeat rows do not increase independent coverage.
pilot.seeds_and_actual_generation: Owned by root generation_protocol.json; no proposals generated by this audit.
pilot.selection: Entire official test matrix, first/last lexicographic observation, before new proposals/outcomes.

precedents.borrow: Use the published five geometry categories by three size bins, with two official test objects per cell. Select all30 independently of reported success.
precedents.limits: Author-defined geometric categories and size bins are retained. This catalog does not claim new performance or universal metric size cutoffs.
precedents.title: Human Universal Grasping

precedents.borrow: Track pose variety separately from object/category generalization. Group all views, proposals and scenarios of one object together.
precedents.facts: The proposal formulation separates orientation from translation/articulation. Its object split separates3251training objects,754unseen instances in seen categories, and1514objects in unseen categories.
precedents.limits: Do not add another generator or copy a robot embodiment/policy. Many seeds on one object do not demonstrate new-object transfer.
precedents.title: UniDexGrasp: Universal Robotic Dexterous Grasping via Learning Diverse Proposal Generation and Goal-Conditioned Policy

precedents.borrow: Separate physical variation such as pose/friction from an observation-noise model. Preserve reliable labels while changing physical scenarios or measurements explicitly.
precedents.limits: Its robust analytic grasp-quality/collision labels are not measured MANO lift/hold outcomes. Its image-wise80/20split is not our object-generalization split; do not add random label errors to create failures.
